title: Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation-Related STAT1 Modulating Ubiquitination Aggravates the Progression of Diabetic Nephropathy via Promoting Inflammatory Response.
authors: Xue, Song; Si, Yingkui; Han, Xue
journal: Journal of interferon & cytokine research : the official journal of the International Society for Interferon and Cytokine Research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究液-液相分离相关STAT1调控泛素化在糖尿病肾病炎症中的作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aims to screen liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS)-related genes modulating ubiquitination for diagnosing patients with diabetic nephropathy (DN). After performing differential gene expression analysis, ssGSEA, and immune infiltration analysis, LLPS-related genes modulating ubiquitination, key immune cells, and immune-related pathways were acquired. The correlations between LLPS-related genes and ubiquitination, key immune-related pathways were explored, respectively. The diagnostic genes were identified by four machine learning algorithms, followed by evaluation to predict the performance of the machine learning models on ubiquitination using receiver operating characteristic curves and a confusion matrix. In vitro experiments were applied to explore the function of signal transducer and activator of transcription 1 (STAT1) in DN. Totally, 513 differentially expressed genes were screened between the DN and control groups. The activity of the ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis pathway exhibited a significant difference between the DN and control samples. The fraction of a total of 10 immune cells exhibited a significant difference between the lower and higher ubiquitination groups. Totally, nine LLPS-related genes modulating ubiquitination were acquired, and these genes modulating ubiquitination were enriched in ubiquitin pathways and significantly positively correlated with the complement, IFN-alpha, and IFN-gamma pathways. Two diagnostic genes were obtained, namely dual specificity tyrosine phosphorylation regulated kinase 2 (DYRK2) and STAT1. Notably, downregulation of STAT1 effectively alleviated IFN-gamma, IFN-alpha, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha levels in D-glucose-treated HK-2 cells, as well as the protein level of FK2. LLPS-related STAT1 modulating ubiquitination accelerates the inflammatory response in DN.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在筛选调控泛素化的液-液相分离（LLPS）相关基因，用于诊断糖尿病肾病（DN）患者。通过进行差异基因表达分析、ssGSEA和免疫浸润分析，获得了调控泛素化的LLPS相关基因、关键免疫细胞和免疫相关通路。分别探讨了LLPS相关基因与泛素化、关键免疫相关通路之间的相关性。通过四种机器学习算法识别诊断基因，随后使用受试者工作特征曲线和混淆矩阵评估机器学习模型在泛素化上的预测性能。采用体外实验探讨信号转导与转录激活因子1（STAT1）在DN中的功能。总共在DN组和对照组之间筛选出513个差异表达基因。泛素介导的蛋白水解通路的活性在DN样本和对照样本之间表现出显著差异。在较低和较高泛素化组之间，总共10种免疫细胞的分数表现出显著差异。总共获得九个调控泛素化的LLPS相关基因，这些调控泛素化的基因富集于泛素通路，并与补体、IFN-α和IFN-γ通路显著正相关。获得两个诊断基因，即双特异性酪氨酸磷酸化调节激酶2（DYRK2）和STAT1。值得注意的是，下调STAT1有效减轻了D-葡萄糖处理的HK-2细胞中IFN-γ、IFN-α、IL-1β和TNF-α的水平，以及FK2的蛋白水平。调控泛素化的LLPS相关STAT1加速了DN中的炎症反应。
